notes.purchase_cash_outlay_method: Balance due FROM buyer on buyer statement ($73,184.18) + earnest already paid ($1,000) = $74,184.18. purchaseClosingCosts = outlay − price = $74,184.18 − $75,000 = −$815.82 (credits for deposit/rent/title outweighed fee lines).
notes.net_sale_proceeds_bank_source: Fedwire $95,474.02 from Infinity Title (b8d7bc01…jpg, 07/15/2025, ref 2025-06-6951) + tax refund $2,931.08 (Sid) = $98405.10 total sale payment received. Tax refund is included ONLY in net proceeds — not also as a property-tax reduction (no double count).
notes.sale_costs_method: saleCosts = sale price $115,000 − total sale payment received $98405.10 = $16594.9. Bridge still embeds settlement passthroughs relative to the wire; the tax refund increases net proceeds and therefore lowers saleCosts. Do not also cut annualPropertyTax for this refund.

passthroughs_in_sale_costs.treatment: Inside saleCosts via net-proceeds bridge; not deducted again from rent collected
